snippet.title: Dream City Apocalypse Special Update Version 1.91 (1 Hour Gameplay Video)
snippet.description: To celebrate 7 years anniversary of the game, Dream City Apocalypse received a special update. The game now use point & click interface to make it easier to interact with the game world. It's now 2 times much faster to traverse between location. There are tons of new character art throughout the game.
